disclaimer.title: Important Notice
disclaimer.warning: Experimental Software - Use at Your Own Risk
disclaimer.intro: Phlox is an experimental project intended for educational and personal experimentation ONLY.
disclaimer.notCertified: AS PROVIDED, IT IS NOT A CERTIFIED MEDICAL DEVICE AND MUST NOT BE USED IN ACTUAL CLINICAL SETTINGS OR FOR CLINICAL DECISION-MAKING.
disclaimer.experimentalCodeBody: The codebase is a work in progress and may contain bugs and inconsistencies.
disclaimer.aiHallucinationsBody: LLM outputs, especially from smaller models, can be unreliable, inaccurate, and may present as plausible but incorrect information. Always verify AI-generated content against trusted sources and use your professional clinical judgment.
disclaimer.noAuthBody: Naively exposing this application to the open internet is highly discouraged. Phlox has no user access controls and minimal input sanitisation.
disclaimer.noComplianceBody: Phlox lacks the necessary security and compliance measures for handling protected health information in regulated environments.
disclaimer.useAtOwnRisk: USE AT YOUR OWN RISK and only for non-clinical, educational purposes unless you have implemented robust security measures and undertaken thorough validation.
disclaimer.license: This software is provided under the MIT License.
disclaimer.agreement: I have read and understand the above warnings. I agree to proceed at my own risk.
